name: candidate-v3
status: Co-retained research model family; isolated build, API, replay and controller diagnostics verified
interpretation: The preload is an effective trim correction inferred from reused flight data. It can absorb unresolved canopy asymmetry, actuator zero and propulsion/geometry error; it is not a measured line length.
selection: Six low-input-variation development windows distributed across each flight favored HR 6 mm and TL 0 mm by mean course error on a small discrete comparison. Remaining previously inspected windows and longer contexts check tradeoffs.

profiles.mission: Default Simulator: stronger ordinary trajectory agreement.
profiles.dynamic_roll: profiles.make_simulator(..., dynamic_roll): roll stiffness1 N m/rad with model-derived level trim correction; stronger fast roll response, stronger powered-HR instability.
